text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was a joint dance lesson with Fine 
Motion. Symboli Kris S was technically 
flawless, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――one. two――one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —How's that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The movements and timing are 
spot-on! And yet...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Surrendering myself—to someone else's 
rhythm... —...is not something... I'm good 
at."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Gaining more experience— might resolve 
it—perhaps."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then there's a ball at an acquaintance's 
estate—would you like to come?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Come on over! It's super fun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ A clumsy――dance――would 
bring―― shame to the Symboli name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Please——...I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so... with the casual vibe of asking 
'Wanna hang out at my place?', I ended up 
joining the party, but—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know. How to invite them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A noble dance party straight out of a 
painting. Unable to even teach her what to 
do, I stand frozen beside Symboli Kris 
S...
choice_data_list: ...Would you care to dance with me?
Let's just catch someone and ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A noble dance party straight out of a 
painting. Unable to even teach her what to 
do, I stand frozen beside Symboli Kris 
S...
choice_data_list: ...Would you care to dance with me?
Let's just catch someone and ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Will you dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...However—Umamusume and humans— have 
different levels of strength... That's 
why—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――So as not to injure you―― I shall dance 
softly――and quietly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being a dance party, they 
continued dancing together endlessly 
without ever changing partners.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because it was someone she knew 
well, Symboli Kris S gradually grew 
accustomed to synchronizing her movements.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh? Kris S, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I can't catch her.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, all you needed to do was ask 
casually. In that caseâwould you care to 
dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course! Go easy on me♪

text_block_list.name: Party Guest A
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, look at that. Lady Fine is going to 
dance. Who is that... she's dancing with?

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, she's from the Symboli 
family... Hmph... Let's see what you've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —All eyes... are on me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I cannot bring shame... to the Symboli 
name. —...My resolve has hardened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... Symboli Kris S delivered a 
flawless, magnificent dance performance 
before the crowd.
